slides.title: HAMPO Launches WiFi and Bluetooth Enabled Ego Camera Module for Untethered Embodied AI Data Collection
slides.tldr: UNTETHERED EGO CAMERA FOR EMBODIED AI DATA COLLECTION
slides.highlight: This ego camera module enables untethered data collection for embodied AI, supporting the development of embodied social robots and interaction in RwB.

slides.title: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
slides.tldr: HYBRID LLM-ABM FRAMEWORK FOR ENERGY ADOPTION
slides.highlight: This work proposes a hybrid framework integrating LLMs into agent-based models to augment behavioral assumptions and scenario specifications, supporting the MIMIC goal of societal-scale simulation using LLM-based agent models.

card.one_liner: A hybrid framework using LLMs to design bounded behavioral rubrics and scenarios for energy adoption ABMs.
card.key_idea: LLMs generate offline, rule-validated behavioral multipliers and techno-economic scenarios that augment, rather than replace, a calibrated logistic adoption model for solar PV adoption by Irish dairy farms.
card.evaluation: Evaluated via 500 Monte Carlo worlds and five random seeds across multiple policy settings; results showed stable, monotonic behavioral ordering and up to 13% adoption increase.
card.limitation: LLM use is offline; rubrics are structured approximations rather than empirical measurements and may be influenced by prompt wording or model bias.

slides.title: SocioGesture: Real-Time and Adaptive Social Gesture Perception for Human-Robot Interaction
slides.highlight: This work introduces a low-latency system for recognizing social cues like invitations and refusals, supporting the RwB goal of enhancing human-robot interaction through embodied social robots.

card.one_liner: SocioGesture is a real-time, adaptive social gesture perception system for robust human-robot interaction.
card.key_idea: A lightweight dual-stream body-hand skeleton model using occlusion-aware training and an uncertainty-driven offline adaptation loop for expanding gesture vocabulary via cloud-based video labeling.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on a custom HRI dataset and NTU RGB+D 60; demonstrated high robustness to occlusion and 25ms latency on NVIDIA Jetson Thor.
card.limitation: Cannot recover information from severe occlusions and relies on slow offline labeling for vocabulary expansion.

slides.title: Establishing a Dynamic Multimodal HRI Dataset for Engagement Analysis with a Humanoid Robot
slides.highlight: This work proposes a data-collection protocol integrating physiological signals, behavioral data, and self-reports to analyze user engagement. It is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction and embodied social robots.

card.one_liner: Proposed experimental design for a multimodal HRI dataset to analyze user engagement during collaborative tasks.
card.key_idea: A synchronized data-collection protocol integrating physiological signals (EDA, PPG), human/robot IMU data, vision streams, and subjective self-reports across three levels of task complexity.
card.evaluation: Planned study with 30 participants using a within-subject design; results are not yet available as this is a proposal.
card.limitation: The paper describes a conceptual design and protocol; the actual dataset has not yet been collected or implemented.

slides.title: Realbotix Testing Humanoid Robots at Live Events
slides.highlight: Realbotix is testing humanoid robots for crowd presentations, which is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots and human-robot interaction.

slides.title: Towards a Foundational Ontology for Identifying and Resolving Contradictions in Dialogue-based Human-Robot Interactions
slides.tldr: ONTOLOGY FOR RESOLVING HRI DIALOGUE CONTRADICTIONS
slides.highlight: This work proposes a foundational ontology (ATFOt) to represent and resolve contradictions in dialogue-based human-robot interactions, supporting the RwB goal of improving human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: A foundational ontology to formally represent and resolve contradictions in dialogue-based human-robot and human-agent interactions.
card.key_idea: Uses METHONTOLOGY and Activity Theory to define contradictions (errors, conflicts, knowledge issues) via Set Theory and First Order Logic across four levels of abstraction.
card.evaluation: Preliminary results include natural language, set theoretic, and FoL definitions. Full evaluation via coverage and competency questions is ongoing in Protege.
card.limitation: The work is currently in the preliminary/ongoing stage; full qualitative studies and verification are not yet completed.

slides.title: C$^{3}$T: Counterfactual Causal Reasoning for Sentiment Shifts in Social-Media Conversation Trees
slides.tldr: CAUSAL REASONING FOR SOCIAL MEDIA SENTIMENT SHIFTS
slides.highlight: This work introduces a model for predicting sentiment shifts and causal attributions in conversation trees, supporting the MIMIC goal of societal-scale simulation and impact analysis of human-AI societies.

card.one_liner: C³T models how specific discourse moves causally drive sentiment shifts within social-media conversation trees.
card.key_idea: A thread-structured Transformer using intervention tags, ancestor attention, and a counterfactual loss to estimate the impact of discourse moves (e.g., toxicity, corrections) on downstream negativity.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on public rumor datasets against neural and LLM baselines using macro-F1 and attribution accuracy; results show superior event-OOD robustness.
card.limitation: Cross-thread spillovers are not modeled, and causal estimates are model-based and conditional on measured context.

slides.title: Development of a Humanoid Robot Prototype for Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction
slides.highlight: This prototype integrates gesture recognition, object detection, and LLM-based voice processing, providing a flexible testbed for embodied social interaction relevant to RwB.

card.one_liner: A low-cost, 3D-printed humanoid robot prototype designed as a flexible testbed for multimodal HRI research.
card.key_idea: Integrates a 12-DOF dual-arm system with AI modules for gesture recognition (MediaPipe/LSTM), object detection (YOLO/ZED 2), and voice-command parsing via LLMs.
card.evaluation: Validated via pick-and-place and gesture tasks; achieved 96% gesture and 92% speech accuracy, with average positioning error of 1.83 cm.
card.limitation: Reliance on external LLM APIs introduces latency and dependency on active internet connectivity.

slides.title: A Physics-Consistent Benchmark for Contact-Rich Human-Robot Interaction in Assistive Care
slides.highlight: This work introduces a benchmark for contact-rich assistive tasks, such as robot-assisted bathing, emphasizing the need for physics-aware screening beyond simple task success. It is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots and human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: A physics-consistent benchmark for assistive care showing that task completion does not imply physically valid contact.
card.key_idea: Combines a deformable, passively responding human model calibrated via manikin force-indentation measurements with physics-aware scoring and a leak-free, vision-only observation protocol.
card.evaluation: Evaluated State Machine, VoxPoser, and $\pi_{0.5}$ across 7 bathing tasks (140 runs/method) using peak force, joint-limit margins, and task success metrics.
card.limitation: Uses a medical manikin instead of real human tissue and lacks systematic sensitivity studies for calibration parameters.

slides.title: Decoupling Turn-Taking from Semantics: A Decoupled Data Approach for Finite-State-Machine-Based Full-Duplex Dialogue
slides.highlight: This work proposes a decoupled data approach to learn turn-taking from real human-human spoken dialogues, contributing to HyECHO's goals of modeling listener behavior and engagement in hybrid teams.

card.one_liner: Improves full-duplex dialogue by learning turn-taking from real human speech and semantics from text.
card.key_idea: A decoupled data approach using rule-based event-guided transformation of human-human speech and a Source-Aware Calibrated (SAC) Loss to balance rare state-transition tokens.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on Switchboard, Fisher, VoiceBench, and Full-Duplex-Bench. Results show significant F1 and semantic gains over synthetic-data baselines and competitive performance against Moshi.
card.limitation: Loss of continuous-time information during serialization, lack of paralinguistic cues, and restriction to two-party QA dialogues.

slides.title: Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Solar PV Policy Design under Uncertainty: An Agent-Based Approach
slides.highlight: This research uses reinforcement learning and agent-based modeling to optimize solar PV adoption policies, aligning with MIMIC's focus on societal-scale simulation and agent-based impact analysis.

card.one_liner: RL-driven adaptive policy design optimizes solar PV adoption and public cost trade-offs using agent-based simulations.
card.key_idea: Integrates PPO, SAC, and TD3 algorithms with a stochastic agent-based model to learn sequential policy interventions (grants, loans, tariffs) via a scalarised reward framework.
card.evaluation: Evaluated using 300 stochastic episodes and compared against static baselines; results show consistent adoption-cost trade-offs across different RL algorithms.
card.limitation: Limited to a 16-year horizon, one geographic context, and a simplified ABM that omits certain behavioral and implementation constraints.

slides.title: IRWOZ 2.0: A Large Language Model-driven Dialogue Dataset for Industrial Robot Conversations
slides.highlight: This work introduces IRWOZ 2.0, a refined dialogue dataset for industrial human-robot interaction, which is relevant to RwB's focus on AI-mediated embodied learning and HRI.

card.one_liner: IRWOZ 2.0 is an LLM-enhanced dialogue dataset improving state-tracking accuracy for industrial human-robot interactions.
card.key_idea: Combines Mistral and Claude-3.5 for automated error correction and synthetic dialogue generation across four industrial domains using structured prompt engineering and hybrid expert validation.
card.evaluation: Evaluated using GPT-2 variants; BLEU-4 scores rose from 0.1651 to 0.5604. Human evaluation by 23 experts confirmed high accuracy and naturalness.
card.limitation: Human evaluation indicated room for improvement in language variation and maintaining dynamic interaction flows during complex multi-step operations.

slides.title: Alignment-Free Text-Audiobox for Voice Dubbing and Full-Duplex Dialogue Synthesis
slides.highlight: This framework enables high-quality full-duplex dialogue synthesis that natively models turn-taking and emotional dynamics, supporting the multimodal social perception goals of HyECHO.

card.one_liner: Text-AB is a unified 3B-parameter framework for high-quality voice dubbing and full-duplex dialogue synthesis.
card.key_idea: A latent diffusion Transformer using DAC-VAE features and flow-matching, which learns text-speech alignment via cross-attention to remove the need for forced alignment.
card.evaluation: Evaluated via human MOS and objective metrics (WER, SpkSim) on internal dubbing and dialogue benchmarks; results show significant gains over internal baselines.
card.limitation: One-shot generation quality degrades notably beyond approximately one minute of speech.

slides.title: Scales, Reflections, and Conversations: A Multi-Modal Approach to Emotion Annotation
slides.highlight: This study explores a participant-centric, multimodal emotion-logging application to capture nuanced emotional variability, supporting HyECHO's goal of multimodal social perception.

card.one_liner: A feasibility study of a multimodal emotion-annotation app allowing users to choose reporting modalities based on context.
card.key_idea: A participant-centric EMA prototype offering three reporting modes: Quick Mode (scales), Detailed Reflections (journaling/multimedia), and LLM-supported Annotations (conversational dialogue) with user-configurable prompting.
card.evaluation: A one-week field study with 33 participants (aged 20-37) using pre-study surveys, in-app logging, feedback surveys, and semi-structured exit interviews.
